newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt ends near flat as crown weakens.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt ends near flat as crown weakens.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Norwegian bonds closed virtually unchanged with few impulses to trade on. The crown weakened to 101.85 versus the European Currency Unit index, compared to 101.73 on Wednesday, on continued profit-taking after recent gains, traders said. Some analysts said the crown could hit 102 before recovering.
* 2007 bond yield three basis points higher at 6.52 pct
* Norway over bunds gap unchanged at 69 points
* Three-month eurokrone five basis points up at 4.35 pct
